Close the sandwich and cut diagonally.
Drain 1 small tin tuna (120 g) and mix with a pinch of salt and pepper.
Lay out 2 slices spelt bread and spread tuna on one slice, add a handful of watercress.
Top with the second bread slice.
Flake 100 g cooked salmon and combine with a squeeze of lemon.

Close the sandwich.

Close and serve.
Reheat 400 ml lentil soup (sweet potato, butternut squash, root veg) until warm.
Pour into a bowl and serve alongside 1 multigrain roll.
Cook 50 g dry wholemeal pasta according to package, drain and cool.
Mix pasta with 100 g chickpeas, 1 cup salad leaves, juice from lime, fresh coriander, and sliced chilli.
Toss gently and plate.
Place 1 wholemeal tortilla on a flat surface.
Layer 150 g roasted sweet potato, 40 g feta cheese, diced red chilli and spring onion in the center.

Add 150 g grilled salmon.

Lay out 2 slices wholegrain bread.

Cut diagonally and serve.
Cook 150 g egg noodles, drain and set aside.
In a hot pan, stir-fry 150 g chicken or shrimp with 150 g mixed vegetables and 1 tbsp soy sauce for 3–4 minutes.
Toss noodles with the stir-fry and serve.
Warm 1 large tortilla in a dry pan, then fold in half.
Fill half with 100 g shredded chicken, 100 g black beans, and 40 g cheddar cheese.

Add 180 g diced sweet potato and 1 cup chopped kale, cook for 5–7 minutes until vegetables soften.

Drain 1 tin tuna (140 g) and mix with 2 tbsp greek yogurt, lemon juice, and salt.
Halve 1 avocado and scoop out a little of the center to make room.
Divide the tuna mixture between the avocado halves and add diced celery (1/2 cup) on top.
Cook 150 g couscous according to package, then cool.
Toss couscous with 120 g chickpeas, 1 cup halved cherry tomatoes and diced cucumber, and 1 tbsp olive oil and balsamic vinegar.
Mix and plate.
Bake 3 eggs with 1 cup spinach, zucchini, and bell pepper in a muffin tin at 350°F for 15–18 minutes.

Place 150 g roasted pork tenderloin on a plate.
